needs_atom.missing: REVEAL-UNTIL DIG for the [-1]: 'Reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card. Put that card into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.' No node iterates the library from the top until a card matching a filter is revealed, and no selector names 'the other revealed cards' to send them to the bottom in a random order. The only existing encoding (Transmogrify, B5b-transmogrify-reveal-creature: SEARCH over Zone(LIBRARY, position=TOP) + REVEAL count QUnbounded) looks at the top card only (documented divergence: a non-creature top card finds nothing), so it would play weaker than printed; Repeat takes a fixed count. The [+1] (Basri Ket's PUT_COUNTER x3 on up to one target creature) and [-6] (Garruk, Unleashed's MODIFY_PT+GRANT_ABILITY TRAMPLE Seq with a single target, +10/+10) map onto existing nodes.
